name.ja: 結合した2周波数系と共鳴の有限窓

note.ja: 半解析解 α=1、ω=10/20、q0=(1,1/ω)、p0=0。中心probeは保存binary64のhとsin/cosをそのまま使い、πへ丸め直しません。 中心の実浮動係数写像はunresolvedとし、理想πのJordan性を移しません。64刻み増幅と小さい固定入力の観測であり、走査した共鳴図・一般安定性・長時間の普遍誤差定理は主張しません。
note.en: Semi-analytic reference alpha=1, omega=10/20, q0=(1,1/omega) and p0=0. Central probes retain the evaluated binary64 h and sin/cos coefficients without snapping to mathematical pi. The central actual floating map remains unresolved; ideal-pi Jordan structure is not transferred to it. Results concern 64-step amplification and small fixed inputs, not a scanned resonance diagram, general stability or a universal long-time error theorem.

note.en: A genuinely coupled two-degree-of-freedom system uses twelve 64-step probes and six accuracy trajectories to separate normal modes, coordinate exchange, discrete maps and roundoff.
